- Jellyfin 12.2's `HarmonizeConflictingUserData` migration merges the play state that Jellyfin stored more than once
  for the same item and user. When those rows agree on the last played date, play count and position but disagree on
  "played", it can pick an unplayed row and mark a watched item unwatched (a Jellyfin bug: no tie-breaker on `Played`).
  From 12.2-3 on, the plugin's `Jellyfin12.2_HarmonizeUserData` migration resolves these rows first, preferring played
  and favourite, so upgrading from 12.1 on PostgreSQL is not affected. A server that already ran the routine (upgraded
  with 12.2-1 or 12.2-2, or upgraded to 12.2 on SQLite before migrating) keeps the result: mark the affected items as
  watched again, in the item's menu or with `POST /UserPlayedItems/{itemId}?datePlayed=<date>`. To migrate a 12.1
  SQLite server, migrate with 12.1-2 and then upgrade the image.
